sources.название: Feature extraction and prediction of spinal cord stimulation evoked compound action potentials in humans
sources.авторы: König, S.; Ramadan, A.; Sullivan, D. et al.
sources.модальность: Epidural SCS ECAP waveforms recorded through two externalized percutaneous leads
sources.задача: Classify individual pulses as ECAP, non-ECAP or artifact and model waveform features across stimulation settings
sources.метод: Artifact cleaning, PCA clustering, K-nearest-neighbor classification and generalized linear mixed-effects models
sources.датасет: Fifteen chronic-pain participants recruited; 30 sessions from eight participants with externalized two-lead SCS selected, followed by exclusion of two sessions from one participant for uncertain electrode alignment
sources.производительность: AUC separated ECAP from non-ECAP better than peak-to-peak amplitude (d'=2.44 versus 2.27); preferred polarities reduced current by about 1.25 mA
sources.кросс_субъект: no: participant variability was modeled, but no held-out-participant validation is reported
sources.ограничения: Eight selected participants out of 15 recruited and 28 retained sessions after two exclusions. Nested k-fold classification selected every 11th waveform per outer loop; no participant-held-out evaluation or external cohort. Underlying data are available only on author request subject to ethics/IRB restrictions. ECAP classes and features are neural-response measures, not pain or treatment outcomes.

provenance.query_or_seed: Feature extraction and prediction of spinal cord stimulation evoked compound action potentials in humans

evidence.population: Fifteen recruited adults with chronic pain; eight contributed 30 selected recording sessions, of which two were excluded for uncertain electrode alignment.
evidence.target_label: Individual-pulse ECAP, non-ECAP or artifact class and waveform features

validation.notes: IOP Version of Record checked through text rendering of the official publisher PDF URL after direct IOP GET returned a Radware CAPTCHA. Methods 2.2 p. 3: 15 recruited, 30 sessions from eight selected, two sessions excluded. Methods 2.7 p. 5: outer cross-validation selects every 11th waveform, not a held-out participant. Table 1 p. 8: AUC median d-prime 2.44 for ECAP versus non-ECAP. Data availability p. 15: author request subject to ethics/IRB restrictions. No patient-level clinical pain outcome or independent validation.

sources.ограничения: Two SCS participants and no independent cohort or participant-disjoint validation. Artifact extraction quality is not pain intensity, analgesic response or cross-patient performance.

sources.название: Combining brain-wide activity imaging with electron microscopy reveals a distributed brain network for processing threatening somatosensory stimuli
sources.авторы: N. Randel; C. Wang; M. S. Clayton; K. Wang; S. Pang; S. C. Xu; A. Champion; H. F. Hess; A. Cardona; P. J. Keller; M. Zlatic
sources.модальность: Нейронная активность
sources.задача: Картирование
sources.метод: Same-specimen larval light-sheet calcium imaging and eFIB-SEM registration, followed by targeted two-photon validation and a separate rolling assay. Version 3 additionally models the larval connectome as a recurrent firing-rate network: synapse counts set connection strengths, predicted neurotransmitters set signs, and simulated Basin activation is compared with observed calcium-response valence. A null ensemble uses 1,000 out-degree-preserving shuffled networks.
sources.датасет: Larva1099 first-instar CNS; separate third-instar neural and behavioral preparations
sources.производительность: In one first-instar CNS, 119 of roughly 3,000 brain neurons responded to Basin activation; 25 responsive lineages and 101/119 traced neurons were reported. Separate third-instar cohorts showed reduced rolling (P=0.0037) and increased turning (P=0.025) after KC silencing during Basin activation (n=366/351; v3 Fig. 5C). Separately, v3 Figure 6 reports connectome-model AUC 0.74 (Mann-Whitney U p=0.045), response-sign accuracy 72.4%, and an out-degree-preserving-shuffle permutation p=0.025. These are author-reported within-study metrics, not reproduced or human validation.
sources.кросс_субъект: Не применимо
sources.ограничения: One first-instar CNS underlies whole-brain imaging and EM registration; validation and rolling assays use other third-instar larvae. Optogenetic Basin stimulation is an experimental proxy for nociceptive input. Calcium responses, circuit anatomy and rolling are distinct endpoints; none measures subjective pain or establishes human transfer. Version 3 Figure 6 does not report the exact evaluated-neuron denominator or a train/test split in the checked text; the reported 72.4% must not be assigned the nearby 20/26 tracing denominator. The graph-null result is a fly-neuron valence comparison, not Drosophila-to-ECAP transfer or clinical SCS evidence.

evidence.population: One first-instar CNS for matched light-sheet/EM mapping; separate third-instar preparations for neuron validation and early third-instar larvae for rolling assays
evidence.sample_size: One first-instar CNS for whole-brain/EM registration; approximately 40 early third-instar larvae per behavioral recording; validation animals counted by experiment
evidence.target_label: Basin-evoked calcium activity and separately measured rolling escape

validation.notes: v3 Figure 6 is a partial biological-model analogue only; exact evaluation N and train/test split are not reported in checked primary text; no human ECAP or SCS transfer.

sources.название: Connectome-constrained networks predict neural activity across the fly visual system
sources.авторы: Janne K. Lappalainen; Fabian D. Tschopp; Sridhama Prakhya; Mason McGill; Aljoscha Nern; Kazunori Shinomiya; Shin-ya Takemura; Eyal Gruntman; Jakob H. Macke; Srinivas C. Turaga
sources.модальность: connectome, neural_activity
sources.задача: Оценка идентифицируемости и вклада структурных ограничений коннектома
sources.метод: Connectome-constrained deep mechanistic network with simplified neurons and synapses, optimized for visual motion
sources.датасет: Compiled adult fly visual-system connectome; official flyvis scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; 64 cell types
sources.производительность: Predicts neural responses across 64 visual-system cell types and tests connectome-derived constraints.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable
sources.ограничения: The 64-cell-type visual network predicts measured single-neuron visual responses. The official flyvis implementation names the compiled scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; this is a constructed file, not a single FlyWire/BANC release. The endpoint is visual function, not VNC, nociception, ECAP or SCS.

provenance.query_or_seed: connectome-constrained dynamics transfer random graph controls

evidence.population: Adult Drosophila visual system; 64 modeled cell types with published functional recordings
evidence.sample_size: 64 modeled optic-lobe cell types; 45,669 model neurons; 1,513,231 model connections across 721 columns; 50 independently trained DMNs; comparisons to published neural recordings from 26 studies (not 26 animals).
evidence.target_label: connectome-constrained neural dynamics

validation.notes: The 64-cell-type visual network predicts measured single-neuron visual responses. The official flyvis implementation names the compiled scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; this is a constructed file, not a single FlyWire/BANC release. The endpoint is visual function, not VNC, nociception, ECAP or SCS. A prior relation to bioRxiv 10.1101/2023.05.02.539144 was removed: that preprint is Shiu et al., a distinct adult-brain model. BioRxiv 10.1101/2023.03.11.532232 matches Lappalainen et al. by title and authors, but a formal publisher-declared version link was not verified. sources.название: A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing
sources.авторы: Philip K. Shiu; Gabriella R. Sterne; Nico Spiller; Romain Franconville; Andrea Sandoval; et al.
sources.модальность: Adult Drosophila FlyWire central-brain connectome, predicted neurotransmitter identity, simulated spike activity, optogenetic activation and feeding/grooming observations
sources.задача: Predict sensorimotor responses in feeding and antennal grooming circuits from a whole-brain connectome model
sources.метод: Brainwide leaky integrate-and-fire model with alpha-synapse dynamics on connectome weights and predicted excitatory/inhibitory identities; sensory and interneuron activation compared with neural and behavioral experiments
sources.датасет: Adult FlyWire central-brain connectome, public materialization v.630, with 127,400 proofread neurons included in the leaky integrate-and-fire model; the article describes over 125,000 neurons and 50 million synaptic connections in the broader connectome.

sources.ограничения: The model concerns adult central-brain feeding and grooming circuits, not VNC walking or nociceptive subjective pain. Authors caution that absolute model firing rates are unreliable because morphology, receptor dynamics, gap junctions, peptides and neuromodulation are omitted. Fly experiments validate scoped circuit hypotheses, not human ECAP or SCS outcomes.

sources.название: painless, a Drosophila Gene Essential for Nociception
sources.авторы: W. Daniel Tracey Jr.; Rachel I. Wilson; Gilles Laurent; Seymour Benzer
sources.модальность: Larval heated-probe and mechanical behavioral assays, multidendritic-neuron genetic silencing, nerve electrophysiology and painless mutant/rescue tests
sources.задача: Identify a gene and peripheral neurons required for thermal and mechanical nociceptive escape in Drosophila larvae
sources.метод: Heated probe rolling assay and EP-element mutant screen; multidendritic GAL4/TeTxLC silencing; larval nerve recordings; painless gene rescue and expression localization
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster larvae; experiment-specific animal and nerve counts in figures, without one whole-study denominator
sources.производительность: Results prose: a 45 mN von Frey mechanical filament evoked rolling in 92% of wild-type larvae (n=36) versus 13% of painless1 mutants (n=31); the mechanical percentages are not assigned to Figure 2E. Figure 2E concerns heat-probe responses. Figure 3C-E reports temperature-linked peripheral nerve firing in wild type and its absence in painless mutants.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no subject-level predictive model
sources.ограничения: Peripheral nerve firing and protective larval rolling are different observables; neither directly measures subjective pain. Genetic silencing does not exclude untargeted neurons. No central connectome, human ECAP, SCS outcome or cross-species validation is provided. The live publisher route was inaccessible here; an archived publisher full-text page was checked.

sources.название: Durability of Clinical and Quality-of-Life Outcomes of Closed-Loop Spinal Cord Stimulation for Chronic Back and Leg Pain: A Secondary Analysis of the Evoke Randomized Clinical Trial
sources.авторы: Nagy Mekhail; Robert M Levy; Timothy R Deer; Leonardo Kapural; Sean Li; Kasra Amirdelfan; Corey W Hunter; Steven M Rosen; Shrif J Costandi; Steven M Falowski; Abram H Burgher; Jason E Pope; Christopher A Gilmore; Farooq A Qureshi; Peter S Staats; James Scowcroft; Tory McJunkin; Jonathan Carlson; Christopher K Kim; Michael I Yang; Thomas Stauss; Julie Pilitsis; Lawrence Poree; Dan Brounstein; Samuel Gilbert; Gerrit E Gmel; Robert Gorman; Ian Gould; Erin Hanson; Dean M Karantonis; Abeer Khurram; Angela Leitner; Dave Mugan; Milan Obradovic; Zhonghua Ouyang; John Parker; Peter Single; Nicole Soliday; Evoke Study Group
sources.модальность: ECAP-controlled closed-loop vs fixed-output open-loop SCS; device-measured neural response (ECAP) alongside VAS pain, PROMIS-29, EQ-5D-5L, ODI, POMS and opioid use
sources.задача: Prespecified 24-month durability analysis of clinical and quality-of-life outcomes in the Evoke randomised controlled trial
sources.метод: Secondary analysis of the double-blind, randomised, controlled, parallel-arm Evoke trial (NCT02924129) with 36 months of follow-up at 13 US sites; analysis performed October 2020 to April 2021. All randomised patients (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop) were included in the 24-month primary outcome analysis using last-observation-carried-forward; per-protocol completers at 24 months were 50 closed-loop and 42 open-loop.
sources.датасет: 134 randomised participants (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop); 24-month per-protocol completers 50 closed-loop and 42 open-loop
sources.производительность: At 24 months, >=50% overall pain reduction in 53/67 (79.1%) closed-loop vs 36/67 (53.7%) open-loop (difference 25.4%, 95% CI 10.0-40.8; P=.001) and >=80% reduction in 31/67 (46.3%) vs 20/67 (29.9%) (difference 16.4%, 95% CI 0.2-32.6; P=.047); no difference in safety profiles (study-related adverse event rate difference 6.0, 95% CI -7.8 to 19.7); quality-of-life, physical and emotional functioning and sleep gains paralleled opioid reduction or elimination
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: randomised controlled trial, not a predictive model
sources.ограничения: Secondary analysis of an already-randomised cohort, not a new trial, so it is not independent evidence relative to the 3- and 12-month Evoke reports. The 24-month primary analysis applies last-observation-carried-forward to all randomised patients, which assumes outcomes stay stable after dropout; only 50 and 42 patients per arm completed the 24-month visit. ECAP is a proxy for neural recruitment and dose, not a direct pain measurement.

sources.название: The Effect of Spinal Cord Stimulation Frequency on the Neural Response and Perceived Sensation in Patients With Chronic Pain
sources.авторы: Gerrit Eduard Gmel; Rosana Santos Escapa; John L Parker; Dave Mugan; Adnan Al-Kaisy; Stefano Palmisani
sources.модальность: Human epidural ECAP and reported stimulation sensation
sources.задача: Characterize how SCS pulse frequency changes ECAP amplitude per pulse and perceived paresthesia strength
sources.метод: Within-patient frequency sweeps at fixed stimulation current and pulse width (2-455 Hz)
sources.датасет: 20 chronic-pain patients recruited; 16 patients/22 analyzable ECAP sweeps; 13 patients/18 sensation sweeps
sources.производительность: ECAP amplitude fell as frequency rose, while reported stimulation sensation increased; no pain-relief endpoint measured
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: within-subject experimental observations, no prediction model
sources.ограничения: Within-patient sweeps without independent validation; high frequencies limited by discomfort; ECAP and paresthesia are not pain intensity or clinical SCS response.

evidence.target_label: ECAP amplitude per pulse and separately rated stimulation sensation across frequency sweeps

validation.notes: Full publisher text checked. No analgesia or future patient outcome is assessed. Repeated sweeps do not increase the patient denominator. Gmel et al. 2023 (DOI 10.3389/fnins.2023.1297814) explicitly reuses this study setup and its 20 recruited patients for a distinct postsynaptic dorsal-column analysis; do not count as independent cohorts.

sources.название: Epidural spinal cord recordings (ESRs): sources of neural-appearing artifact in stimulation evoked compound action potentials
sources.авторы: Ashlesha Deshmukh; Megan Settell; Kevin Cheng; Bruce Knudsen; James Trevathan; Maria LaLuzerne; Stephan Blanz; Aaron Skubal; Nishant Verma; Ben Romanauski; Meagan Brucker-Hahn; Danny Lam; Igor Lavrov; Aaron Suminski; Douglas Weber; Lee Fisher; Scott Lempka; Andrew Shoffstall; Hyunjoo Park; Erika Ross; Mingming Zhang; Kip Ludwig
sources.модальность: ECAP, back-muscle EMG, movement/physiology and stimulation artifact
sources.задача: Characterize neural-appearing non-neural components that contaminate epidural spinal cord recordings during SCS
sources.метод: In-vivo swine artifact characterization using an Abbott Octrode; vecuronium, EMG, post-mortem recordings and movement/physiology analyses
sources.датасет: Seven swine enrolled; six analyzed; analysis-specific subsets vary. Supporting data are in article and supplements; no separate patient-level dataset.
sources.производительность: Capacitive decay, EMG bleed-through and motion can resemble or contaminate ECAP components; no predictive performance metric.
sources.кросс_субъект: No cross-subject prediction or held-out subject validation; descriptive animal experiment.
sources.ограничения: Swine technical artifact study, not human pain measurement or clinical validation. No physical ECAP forward operator. Same consortium as Verma et al. 2023 (PMID 36855060), so it is not external validation. The 2024 bioRxiv preprint is a version of this study, not an independent replication. Analysis-specific denominators vary. Verma et al. 2023 is now canonical S800 and belongs to the same consortium with substantial author overlap; the two studies are related technical evidence, not independent external validation.

provenance.query_or_seed: PA-04 backward citation screen of ECAP/SCS primary sources; S764 and Verma et al. 2023 (PMID 36855060)

evidence.population: Swine epidural SCS model; seven enrolled and six analyzed; denominators vary across analyses.
evidence.target_label: Presence and temporal/morphological contamination of epidural recordings by capacitive decay, back-muscle EMG bleed-through and motion artifact; not pain labels.

validation.notes: Publisher text checked through an accessible text-reader route; direct IOP page returned CAPTCHA. Methods 2.1-2.4, Results 3.1-3.7, Figs. 1-13 and Tables 1-2, Discussion 4.1/4.7 and data statement reviewed. Same consortium as Verma et al. 2023 (PMID 36855060); related same-group evidence, not external validation. Seven swine enrolled, six analyzed, smaller analysis-specific denominators. No human pain outcome and no FEM/axon physical forward operator. Data are within article/supplements; no linked patient-level download identified. Same consortium as S800 (Verma et al. 2023; substantial author overlap); related technical evidence, not independent external validation.

sources.название: The role of Drosophila Piezo in mechanical nociception
sources.авторы: Sung Eun Kim; Bertrand Coste; Abhishek Chadha; Boaz Cook; Ardem Patapoutian
sources.модальность: Calibrated von Frey larval behavior, ex vivo cell-attached recordings from isolated ppk-positive neurons, genetic knockout/RNAi/rescue, heat and gentle-touch controls
sources.задача: Test dPiezo contribution to larval mechanical nociception and mechanically activated currents in ppk-positive neurons.
sources.метод: Dpiezo knockout, ppk-cell knockdown and rescue; von Frey-evoked rolling; heat/gentle-touch controls; dissociated ppk-positive larval neuron cell-attached recordings under pipette suction.

sources.название: Trust-gated synthetic EEG augmentation reduces performance drops when generalizing to new patients
sources.авторы: Daniel Choi; Cordelia Yip; Andrew Choi; Junho Park
sources.модальность: Resting-state EEG in PainMunich chronic-pain case/control cohort; separate BCI IV-2a motor-imagery EEG stress-test dataset.
sources.задача: Control the risk that synthetic EEG augmentation worsens subject-disjoint case/control or motor-imagery classification on held-out real people.
sources.метод: For each subject-disjoint fold, a conditional latent-diffusion generator is fit on real training subjects only; a separate geometry-aware teacher fit on real training windows filters synthetic candidates by label consistency and confidence quantile. A fail-closed selector injects accepted windows only if held-out validation AUROC beats a real-only model by margin 0.01. Five-fold participant-disjoint CV with five seeds compares paired augmentation and real-only runs.
sources.датасет: PainMunich resting-state EEG dataset 1: 189 people (101 chronic-pain cases, 88 healthy controls); a separate BCI Competition IV-2a motor-imagery dataset has 9 people. Publisher Data availability links PainMunich BIDS-EEG on OSF and BCI IV-2a portal, with original-provider terms applying. Author code is linked from the publisher Code availability section.
sources.производительность: PainMunich at 5% training-subject scarcity: ungated augmentation caused test AUROC decline >0.01 in 56% of paired runs, versus 24% with trust-gated augmentation at q=0.99; mean AUROC was comparable. BCI IV-2a at 25% scarcity: AUROC 0.679 versus 0.627 and harm rate 0.16 versus 0.44. These are within-paper subject-disjoint results, not external clinical validation or patient outcomes.
sources.кросс_субъект: Participant-disjoint train/validation/test in five-fold CV repeated over five seeds; scarcity subsamples only training subjects. Generator and teacher fit only real training subjects/windows per fold. PainMunich test labels are chronic-pain case/control, not pain intensity.
sources.ограничения: This is a partial NS-06 analogue: labelled real training plus synthetic augmentation under participant shift, not synthetic-only source transfer or unlabeled-target alignment. The PainMunich label distinguishes chronic-pain cases from controls, not pain intensity, subjective relief, treatment response or SCS/ECAP outcome. The BCI benchmark is a different motor-imagery task, not a separate chronic-pain cohort. Author-defined harm is ΔAUROC degradation, a model-performance safety proxy rather than patient harm. Dataset access follows original provider terms; reported CV does not establish clinical deployment generalization.

sources.название: A frozen rate operator from the complete larval connectome: degree and weight govern the gross response, exact wiring governs input routing and mushroom-body modes
sources.авторы: Stavros Therianos
sources.издание: arXiv preprint arXiv:2606.17745v2 [q-bio.NC], 21 pages, 6 figures, CC BY 4.0; v1 (submitted 16 Jun 2026) carried the different title 'Separating wiring-specific from statistical control of dynamics in a complete connectome'
sources.модальность: Larval Drosophila connectome run as a frozen leaky-tanh rate operator; simulated state covariance, eigenvalue and singular spectra, mode leverage; degree-and-weight double-edge-swap ensemble, cell-class block-preserving null, unstructured Gaussian control
sources.задача: Separate which dynamical properties of the complete larval connectome operator are fixed by degree and weight statistics and which require the exact placement of synapses, using level-matched null ensembles
sources.метод: 3,013-neuron larval connectome; 2,825-neuron strongly connected core; W[i,j] = reconstructed synapse count from j to i, rescaled to spectral radius rho* = 0.99; frozen leaky-tanh update x_n = (1-alpha) x_{n-1} + alpha tanh(W x_{n-1} + B s_n) with alpha = 0.9 and no fitted single-neuron parameter; metrics: non-normality sigma1/rho, participation-ratio effective rank, near-linearity, identity-resolved mode leverage, sparse afferent-port-drive active fraction; controls: 1,000-instance degree-and-weight rewiring ensemble (seeds 2000-2999), block-preserving 18-cell-class null, unstructured Gaussian operator, 1,000 random size-matched sets (seed 19019), singular-subspace guard, Westfall-Young family-wise max-statistic control over a 105-entry panel
sources.датасет: Winding et al. 2023 larval Drosophila connectome (Science 379:eadd9330): 3,013 neurons and 111,243 directed edges, edge weights equal reconstructed synapse counts and are used as magnitudes without sign. Strongly connected core 2,825 neurons and 109,438 internal edges with 536 self-loops; periphery 80 afferent ports (524 couplings), 97 efferent ports (1,161 couplings), 11 internal. Derived result files, integrity manifest, seeds and verification bundle at https://github.com/Stavros963/fcta; the connectome itself comes from the original public source.

sources.название: Mouse to Human Cross-Species Transfer Learning for Electrophysiology-to-Transcriptomics Mapping in Cortical GABAergic Interneurons
sources.авторы: Theo Schwider; Ramin Ramezani
sources.модальность: Patch-seq current-clamp electrophysiology (IPFX features, 12 feature families) paired with transcriptomic GABAergic interneuron subclass labels (Lamp5, Pvalb, Sst, Vip, Sncg); NWB recordings from Allen Institute mouse visual cortex and human neurosurgical neocortex.
sources.задача: Reproduce the Gouwens IPFX/sPCA random-forest baseline for transcriptomic subclass prediction and test mouse-to-human cross-species transfer learning on an aligned 4-class interneuron task.
sources.метод: IPFX (v2.1.2) feature extraction into 12 feature families; sparse PCA (44 sPCs) plus a class-balanced random-forest baseline; attention-based BiLSTM over the family-vector tensor (no sPCA); class weighting, SMOTE (train-only) and an ArcFace variant; joint shared-encoder two-head mouse+human pretraining followed by human-only fine-tuning; mouse 60/20/20 hold-out and human 5-fold stratified cross-validation.
sources.датасет: Allen Institute public Patch-seq data via DANDI: DANDI:000020 mouse visual cortex (version 0.210913.1639, 3,699 neurons after QC) and DANDI:000636 human interneuron Patch-seq (version 0.241120.0510, 506 neurons after QC), plus the human_patchseq_gaba metadata repository associated with Lee et al. (2023).
sources.производительность: Mouse random forest 0.8728 macro-F1 / 90.72% accuracy; mouse ArcFace BiLSTM+attention+SMOTE 0.8869 +/- 0.0186 macro-F1 and 0.9212 accuracy (Table 4) while the Results text states 0.8923 / 0.9235 for the same configuration, an unresolved internal inconsistency. Human random forest 0.6589 macro-F1 / 75.18% accuracy; human BiLSTM+attention 0.6685 +/- 0.0141. Transfer learning on the aligned 4-class task: human-only baseline 0.6580 +/- 0.0286 -> mouse-pretrained 0.6795 +/- 0.0120 macro-F1; accuracy 0.7710 +/- 0.0172 -> 0.7905 +/- 0.0096.
sources.ограничения: The only human data are 506 public Allen Institute Patch-seq neurons from anonymized neurosurgical resections; no donor, session, cortical-area or batch variable is reported, and donor-held-out generalisation is not tested, so the reported human 5-fold cross-validation may share donors between training and evaluation folds. The two Tables 4/5 and Results text disagree on the best mouse ArcFace numbers. The mouse-to-human transfer gain (about +0.02 macro-F1) is small, single-direction and evaluated only within the same public dataset. Code and harmonized metadata are announced as placeholders (GitHub link not yet populated). No human ECAP, SCS treatment, chronic-pain, nociception or clinical outcome is measured or predicted; transfer to human pain or SCS use is not shown by this paper and must not be assumed.

sources.название: Parameter-Dependent Effects of Spinal Cord Stimulation on Neural Activation and Evoked Compound Action Potentials
sources.авторы: Meagan K. Brucker-Hahn; Hans J. Zander; David A. Dinsmoor; Scott F. Lempka
sources.издание: bioRxiv preprint (openRxiv), v1 posted 2026-08-04, CC BY 4.0; not peer reviewed
sources.модальность: Simulated SCS-induced ECAP waveforms, extracellular electric fields and dorsal-column axon recruitment
sources.задача: Systematically characterize how anatomical (dorsal CSF thickness), stimulation (pulse width, interphase interval, waveform shape, configuration, frequency) and recording parameters shape dorsal-column activation and SCS-induced ECAPs
sources.метод: Hybrid computational model: FEM volume conductor of the lower thoracic spine in COMSOL (mesh in 3-matic, literature conductivities) coupled to multicompartment sensory axon models in NEURON; 100 dorsal-column positions by axon diameters 6.0-15.9 um in 0.1 um steps (10,000 axons); reciprocity-based calculation of ECAPs at the recording contacts; parameter sweeps over dCSF thickness, recording pairs, pulse width, IPI, biphasic/triphasic waveforms, four stimulation configurations and 50-1000 Hz
sources.датасет: No new experimental data and no public data or code deposit stated in the checked text. Model geometry, tissue conductivities and fiber morphometry come from literature; a human clinical ECAP dataset is used only to match the median model bipolar electrode impedance (911 ohm).
sources.производительность: Simulated results only. dCSF 1->5 mm raised ET/DT by about 640% (1.2->8.9 mA and 1.7->12.5 mA). Pulse width 90->300 us lowered ET/DT by about 60% and delayed N1/P2 peaks by 0.22-0.30 ms. Guarded-cathode had the lowest thresholds (ET/DT 3.6/5.0 mA) versus wide-bipolar 3.7/5.2 and bipolar 3.8/5.3 mA. 50->1000 Hz raised ET from 3.7 to 5.3 mA and active fibers at DT by about 246% (1547->5353) while mean ECAP amplitude fell about 50% (20.7->8.8 uV). Similar ECAP amplitudes could mask differences in underlying recruitment.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable
sources.ограничения: In-silico study with no enrolled participants or animals and no patient-linked SCS, analgesia or pain outcome. Model ECAPs exclude electrical and biological noise (stimulation, movement, respiratory and EMG artifact). Dorsal rootlets, axon trajectory variability and patient-specific anatomy, tissue properties and lead placement are not modeled; anatomy is an averaged literature-based FEM. The human ECAP dataset enters only as an impedance-matching scalar, not as an outcome. No independent human ECAP recording is used to validate the model, so no transfer to human ECAP morphology, recruitment or clinical dose control is established. ECAP is not a direct measure of pain.

sources.название: A generalized activating function for rapid and accurate neural response prediction in spinal cord stimulation
sources.авторы: Taylor H. Newton; Javier García Ordóñez; Abdallah Alashqar; Vincent Gemar; Andreas Rowald; Jocelyne Bloch; Grégoire Courtine; Niels Kuster; Esra Neufeld
sources.издание: Communications Biology (Article in Press, 2026; volume, issue and article number not assigned at check date)
sources.модальность: Simulated extracellular potential, subthreshold membrane polarization, axon activation thresholds and spike-initiation location/timing (in-silico only)
sources.задача: Rapid and accurate prediction of SCS-evoked neural activation (axon recruitment thresholds and spike initiation) and its use for pulse-waveform and multipolar electrode optimization
sources.метод: Generalized activating function (GAF): convolution of the extracellular potential with a Green's-function kernel (FFT) capturing subthreshold membrane polarization including axial-current diffusion, leakage and pulse shape; threshold-crossing criterion with calibrated critical voltage Vc; verified against NEURON multi-compartment (MRG/SENN) simulations; PyTorch automatic-differentiation multipolar optimization and Dakota MOGA Pareto pulse-waveform search
sources.датасет: No new human data: patient-specific lumbosacral reconstruction (700 myelinated double-cabled axon models; 16-contact epidural paddle lead) reused from Rowald et al. Per-figure input/source data and analysis scripts deposited at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20139935; NEURON reference models on ModelDB
sources.производительность: GAF vs NEURON over 7000 paired observations (700 axons x 10 pulse widths): activation-threshold R2 = 0.99 (classical AF R2 = 0.14), spike-time R2 = 0.91, spike-location R2 = 0.98; median threshold difference 2.3% (IQR 1.1-3.5%); up to ~1000x and ~260x speedups; Pareto pulse optimization ~7x energy efficiency; multipolar selectivity index 82% vs 52% clinical benchmark. In-silico comparison, not clinical efficacy
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable
sources.ограничения: In-silico methods paper: no human ECAP recording, no patient-linked ECAP or outcome link, and no clinical-outcome or human-transfer validation. The GAF is restricted to the subthreshold regime and does not model conduction block, refractoriness or other active-membrane dynamics; calibrated Vc was not invariant for short pulses and sub-internodal source-fiber separations. A single reused patient-specific anatomy is modeled; individual-patient validation is not demonstrated. Code (s4l_neurfunctions) is proprietary to Sim4Life, limiting independent rerun.

provenance.query_or_seed: 10.1038/s42003-026-10849-x generalized activating function SCS neural response prediction

evidence.population: Computational lumbosacral spinal-cord model with 700 myelinated double-cabled axon models, derived from a previously published human MRI reconstruction (Rowald et al.); no newly enrolled participants
evidence.target_label: Model-predicted axon activation thresholds, spike-initiation location and timing, dorsal-root recruitment and functional selectivity index; no ECAP waveform, pain or clinical outcome is measured

validation.notes: Publisher 'Article in Press' accepted-manuscript PDF (17 pp.; HTTP 200, 2026-09-30) read in full: abstract, Results (GAF verification, Rowald et al. reproduction, multipolar and pulse-waveform optimization), Discussion/limitations, Methods and Data/Code availability. The GAF is verified only against NEURON multi-compartment simulations and a computational reproduction of Rowald et al.; no human ECAP, pain or SCS treatment outcome is measured or linked and no independent external cohort is used. The checked version is an accepted manuscript subject to replacement by the final Version of Record; PubMed and Europe PMC had not indexed the record by DOI or exact title at check date.

relations.note: Data availability deposits per-figure input/source data and analysis scripts for this article; entities are recorded as related and are not merged.

sources.название: Nociception and hypersensitivity involve distinct neurons and molecular transducers in Drosophila
sources.авторы: Pengyu Gu; Fei Wang; Ye Shang; Jingjing Liu; Jiaxin Gong; Wei Xie; Junhai Han; Yang Xiang
sources.издание: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, 119(12), e2113645119 (published online 2022-03-16; issue date 2022-03-22)
sources.модальность: Thermal stimulus and nocifensive rolling behavior; genetic perturbation; larval-brain calcium imaging
sources.задача: Dissect whether acute heat nociception and tissue-injury-induced heat hypersensitivity in Drosophila larvae use the same neurons and molecular transducers.
sources.метод: Third-instar larval heat-probe rolling assays; brief UVC epidermal injury to induce hypersensitivity; TrpA1 isoform knockout/knockin and tissue-specific RNAi/perturbation; optogenetic and thermogenetic activation; GCaMP calcium imaging of larval CNS neurons; pharmacologic PLC manipulation.
sources.датасет: Primary experimental data reported in the article; no separate reusable dataset identifier found in the checked article record.
sources.производительность: Acute heat nociception required TrpA1-D in peripheral C4da sensory neurons, whereas UVC injury-induced heat allodynia required TrpA1-C in larval brain BLA neurons; BLA synaptic transmission and Tachykinin receptor/Gq/PLC signaling were implicated in injury-induced heat responses. The paper reports behavioral and calcium-imaging experiments, not a predictive model benchmark.
sources.кросс_субъект: Not a human or cross-subject prediction study; experiments compare Drosophila larval genotypes and perturbations.
sources.ограничения: Drosophila larval mechanistic study of heat-evoked nocifensive rolling and injury-induced hypersensitivity. Rolling is a nociceptive/protective behavioral readout, not evidence of subjective pain. Does not assess human pain, clinical outcomes, ECAP, SCS, or transfer between species. Exact per-condition sample counts are referred to as bracketed values in figure legends but are not stated numerically in the checked machine-readable article text; sample_size therefore remains null.

Acute heat nociception and UVC tissue-injury-induced heat allodynia are experimentally distinguished: TrpA1-D/C4da peripheral sensory neurons for acute nociception versus TrpA1-C/brain BLA neurons for allodynia, with Tachykinin receptor/Gq/PLC modulation. Figure legends say sample numbers are indicated in brackets; specific per-condition n values are not transcribed in the checked machine-readable XML text, so sample_size is null. This is fly larval nociceptive/protective behavior, not subjective pain or evidence about human clinical outcomes, ECAP, SCS, or cross-species transfer.

sources.название: How much of fly walking is written in the wiring?
sources.авторы: Isabel Guan; Yuntian Zhao; Dingyuan Zhang; Shipeng Lyu; I-Ming Chen
sources.модальность: connectome, simulation_state
sources.задача: Test which fly leg-motor outputs depend on the specific ventral nerve cord wiring rather than generic graph statistics.
sources.метод: Fixed-synapse-weight rate models of two adult male VNC connectomes, six families of rewired network controls, prespecified antagonist-coordination criteria and fresh-noise confirmation runs.
sources.датасет: MaleCNS v1.0 and MANC v1.0 connectome leg-motor subnetworks (10,173 and 10,440 model neurons); source data attached to the preprint.
sources.производительность: Author-reported primary-window antagonist score S=0.312 for MaleCNS versus at most 0.144 for the rewired networks, and S=0.173 for MANC versus at most 0.084. Rhythmicity itself was often achieved by rewired networks; these are model outputs, not observed animal performance.
sources.кросс_субъект: Two independently reconstructed male adult fly connectomes were compared; no held-out animal/clinical evaluation.
sources.ограничения: The outputs concern a rate-model leg-motor circuit and antagonist coordination, not nociception, human ECAP or SCS. Glutamatergic transmission was assumed inhibitory; results are model-only, with no body or sensory feedback and no recording-based test of predicted phase relationships. MANC effects are weaker than MaleCNS. Preprint, not a peer-reviewed journal result.

validation.notes: Official arXiv v1 HTML and abstract checked. Figure 1/Results specify two VNC connectomes, 20 antagonist pool pairs per connectome and graph-preserving null families. Figure 2 reports simulated coordination and rhythm separately. Methods report 20 fresh-noise runs for confirmation; these runs are not independent animals. Discussion explicitly says conclusions concern the model, not the animal, and predicted phase relationships remain to be compared with walking-fly recordings. No nociception, human ECAP, SCS or clinical outcome is demonstrated. The arXiv page labels DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2609.38665 as pending registration; it is not stored as a confirmed DOI.

compatibility_rules.condition: Targets must be harmonized as protocol-defined experimental classes; modality-specific encoders and participant-disjoint splits remain mandatory.
A common metric is allowed only after a single compatible self-report definition, scale transform, time reference, and population scope are pre-registered; otherwise evaluate separately.
Behavioral annotation remains a separate endpoint.
Responsiveness to a potentially nociceptive procedure remains separate from self-reported pain.
Resting-state group phenotype remains separate from evoked experimental and self-report targets.
